messages: Elaine: Quick design check — validation + destructive confirm patterns for console forms. Want to land on a small set we use across: required markers, inline feedback on blur, top-summary on submit fail, and type-to-confirm for destructive actions. Thoughts? Samuel: +1 to consistent required marker. Can we avoid color-only? Marta: agree on no color-only. Suggest a11y: visible asterisk plus screen-reader text (aria-hidden on asterisk, aria-label on label). Devin: for inline vs summary: I prefer inline errors on blur for good UX, but keep an error summary at the top after submit that lists issues and anchors to fields. Elaine: that matches my thinking. Quick microcopy options for confirm dialog: (A) "Type DELETE to confirm" (B) "Are you sure? This cannot be undone." (C) "Delete deployment and associated logs?" Which do we prefer for destructive actions in infra flows? Marta: For infra we should be explicit about scope: show what will be deleted and require typing full resource name when it can be costly. So type-to-confirm is ok for high-risk items. Samuel: Maybe tiered: low-risk = simple modal with bold warning + primary/destructive buttons; high-risk = type-to-confirm plus checkbox acknowledging backups. Devin: Also think about keyboard-only users: make sure focus lands in the confirmation input when type-to-confirm appears. Elaine: accessibility nit — required marker color contrast can fail when we only use red. Proposal: required marker uses token "danger" only for errors; otherwise use neutral asterisk with sr-only text. Example: ```html ``` Marta: Love the snippet. Also add role=\"alert\" on inline error messages so screenreaders announce them on blur. Samuel: For inline validation behavior: on blur validate and show message; on input clear message but don't revalidate until blur to avoid noise. On submit, validate all and show top summary with small list of links. Devin: UX detail — when summary appears, set focus to summary region and provide "Jump to first error" link. That helps keyboard users. Elaine: Copy tweak for summary header: "Please fix the following fields to continue" vs "There are problems with your submission" — which reads better? Marta: "Please fix the following fields to continue" is more actionable. Samuel: +1 actionable. DesignBot: New Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/validation-patterns — updated mock for delete flow and form states (v3). Elaine: Small question about button styles: should required fields or invalid states affect primary CTA state? I prefer CTA stays enabled but prevent submit with inline blocking — otherwise we get confusing disabled forms. Devin: Agreed — keep CTA enabled but show real-time inline hints; on submit block and show summary. Marta: One more accessibility note: avoid relying on placeholder text as labels. Screen reader users need persistent labels. Samuel: Final checklist draft I can turn into a PR for the design system: 1) Required marker pattern + sr-only text 2) Inline on-blur validation + role=\"alert\" 3) Submit-time summary with focus management 4) Tiered confirm modals (simple vs type-to-confirm) 5) Microcopy templates for confirm dialogs and errors. Elaine: Perfect — can you put that into a short RFC? Sam, please include links to a11y docs and the Figma above. Samuel: On it. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup: Devin: Thanks team. Marta: LGTM Elaine: Closing — we'll adopt this as default for next console iteration. :tada:
